articles.title: Musings: Too Little, Too Late in Washington
Game Day Guide: Stars at Sabres
Heika’s Take: Stars stack another strong showing in shutout win over Sabres

out.detail: lower body injury, will miss at least the next two games after blocking a shot in a 5-0 win against the San Jose Sharks on Monday

away.summary: The Dallas Stars are coming off a 4-0 shutout win over the Buffalo Sabres, marking their second consecutive shutout and building momentum early in the season. Jake Oettinger is confirmed as the starting goalie after back-to-back shutouts. The team will be without Matt Duchene (lower body), Joel Kiviranta (lower body, out for at least two games), and scratched defenseman Kyle Capobianco.

out.detail: traded to Edmonton for Spencer Stastney

doubtful.detail: non-roster status; will need a subsequent move once activated, not playing on recent trips but skating to get up to speed after personal leave following his father's death

home.summary: The Pittsburgh Penguins are dealing with roster adjustments following a 5-3 loss to the Washington Capitals, where Bryan Rust made his season debut. Arturs Silovs is projected to start in goal after his first loss of the season. The team traded Filip Hallander to Edmonton for Spencer Stastney to bolster defensive depth, and Andrei Kuzmenko remains on non-roster status after a personal leave of absence due to a family tragedy, with his return to gameplay pending.
